decision_conditions:
The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

<p>All new external facing and roofing materials in respect of all the works hereby approved (and any other incidental works carried out in this connection) shall match those of the existing building in respect of materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance including type, size, colour, bond, pointing, coursing, jointing, profile and texture, notwithstanding the details within the approved plans.&nbsp;</p><p>

REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area.</p>

<p>Within one month of the first occupation of the development, evidence must be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority to demonstrate that the green roof has been fully installed in accordance with the required design specifications. The submission for approval must include the following details alongside the completion evidence:</p><ul><li>Cross-section drawings verifying a minimum substrate depth of no less than 80-100mm;</li><li>Details of the installed roof drainage infrastructure;Details of the completed planting mix, incorporating a minimum of 16+ diverse species; and</li><li>A Management and Maintenance Plan, including defined access arrangements, irrigation provisions, and ongoing seasonal care schedules.</li></ul><p>The green roof shall be retained thereafter for the lifetime of the development and managed in strict accordance with the approved management and maintenance details.</p><p>Reason: To promote biodiversity on site through green roofs.</p>
description: Erection of a single storey ground floor rear extension
